THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GARCIA, SERGIO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GRC ROOFING, INC. GARCIA HAS NOT PROVIDED EVIDENCE THAT THE ACCIDENT CAUSED HIS INJURY OR THAT HIS BILLS WERE REASONABLY NECESSARY AND RELATED TO THIS ACCIDENT.
